findings.evidence: `Lagrangian/Basic.lean:63` defines `orthogonal`; :85 `le_orthogonal_orthogonal`, :160 `finrank_orthogonal`, :165 `orthogonal_orthogonal` are the same one-line wrappers over the same Mathlib file, which :7 already imports (`Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForm.Orthogonal`, containing `nondegenerate_restrict_of_disjoint_orthogonal` at :196 and `isCompl_orthogonal_iff_disjoint` at :300). None of the five lemmas mentions `AlmostComplexStructure`.
findings.fix: Move `restrict`, `restrict_apply`, `nondegenerate_restrict_of_disjoint_orthogonal`, `isCompl_orthogonal_iff_disjoint` and `disjoint_orthogonal_orthogonal` into `Lagrangian/Basic.lean` beside `orthogonal`/`orthogonal_orthogonal`/`finrank_orthogonal` (the last two into its existing `FiniteDimensional` section); put `isSymplectomorphism_prodEquivOfIsCompl` in a small new module (e.g. `Geometry/Symplectic/Restrict.lean`) importing Lagrangian/Basic, Prod/Basic and SymplecticTransport, and have `ExistsCompatible.lean` import it.
findings.issue: `restrict`/`restrict_apply` (85, 92), `nondegenerate_restrict_of_disjoint_orthogonal` (99), `isCompl_orthogonal_iff_disjoint` (130), `disjoint_orthogonal_orthogonal` (136) and `isSymplectomorphism_prodEquivOfIsCompl` (146) are general symplectic-subspace/complement API with no dependence on almost complex structures or compatibility. Placing them in a file named for one existence theorem means symplectic reduction or the `Sym^g` local models — which the file's own docstring (63-65) names as future consumers — must import `ExistsCompatible` and its whole cone (Finrank, Lagrangian/TotallyReal, Prod, SymplecticTransport) to get `SymplecticForm.restrict`.

findings.evidence: `apply_smul_add_smul` is proved from `self_eq_zero` and `neg_eq` only (AlmostComplex.lean:362, 367); `exists_apply_eq_one` is proved from `ω.separatingLeft` (AlmostComplex.lean:387). AlmostComplex.lean is 535 lines, well under the enforced limit (largest repo file is 1410 lines), so there is room.
findings.fix: Move all four into `Geometry/Symplectic/AlmostComplex.lean`, next to `self_eq_zero`/`neg_eq`/`separatingLeft` in the `SymplecticForm` namespace.
findings.issue: `apply_smul_add_smul` (105), `apply_smul_add_smul_right` (114), `apply_smul_add_smul_left` (120) and `exists_apply_eq_one` (182) are elementary consequences of alternation and nondegeneracy that use nothing beyond the `SymplecticForm` definition itself; they are broadly useful evaluation/nondegeneracy facts stranded behind the existence proof.

summary: The existence theorem and its plane machinery are correctly placed in a new Geometry/Symplectic module, but the file also carries general symplectic-subspace API (restriction, complement splitting) and elementary alternating-form lemmas that depend on nothing past the SymplecticForm definition; leaving them here forces any future user to import the whole compatible-structure existence proof.
